## Context

The owner explicitly authorized repairing the global Symphony runtime after BOS governance rollout exposed that the active service cannot launch its configured `codex app-server`: `codex` is absent from the WSL service PATH. The failure leaves tengo-suerte Issue #122 in repeated pre-session retries and affects the shared queue.

## Expected outcome

Symphony resolves an explicit, verified Codex launcher, restarts without raising concurrency, launches a real app-server session for the existing tengo-suerte AgentRun, and preserves all queued Issue identities and workspaces.

## Scope

- Identify the installed Codex app-server executable or create a minimal host launcher
- Update the active host WORKFLOW command without storing credentials
- Validate command startup and restart the Symphony runtime safely
- Verify tengo-suerte Issue #122 resumes the same AgentRun and creates a session

## Out of scope

- Changing product repositories
- Increasing Symphony max_concurrent_agents
- Cancelling or duplicating queued Issues
- Changing credentials or approval policy

## Acceptance criteria

- The configured command resolves in the Symphony service environment.
- A bounded `codex app-server` smoke reaches protocol initialization.
- Symphony restarts with max_concurrent_agents unchanged.
- tengo-suerte Issue #122 resumes its existing run and no duplicate Issue, run, branch, or PR is created.
